cases.description: Test with a lowercase string that should remain unchanged as no uppercase letters are present.
Test with a string that starts with an uppercase letter. It should convert the first letter to lowercase.
Test with a camel case string where only the first letter of the second word is uppercase. It should insert an underscore and convert the uppercase letter to lowercase.
Test with a string where both words start with uppercase letters. It should convert the first letter to lowercase and insert an underscore before the second word.
Test with a string where the first word is in all uppercase letters. It should convert each uppercase letter to lowercase and insert underscores between them.
Test with a string where the second word is in all uppercase letters. It should convert each uppercase letter to lowercase and insert underscores between them.
Test with a string that is entirely in uppercase letters. It should convert each letter to lowercase and insert underscores between them.
Test with an empty string. It should return an empty string as there are no characters to process.
Test with a string that is already in YAML format (lowercase with underscores). It should remain unchanged.
Test with a string where multiple consecutive uppercase letters are present at the end of the string. It should convert each uppercase letter to lowercase and insert underscores between them.
Test with a string where multiple consecutive uppercase letters are at the beginning of the string. It should convert each uppercase letter to lowercase and insert underscores between them.
Test with a string where multiple uppercase letters are interspersed with lowercase letters. It should convert each uppercase letter to lowercase and insert underscores between them.

Test with a string where multiple uppercase letters are at the beginning followed by a word and then another word starting with an uppercase letter. It should convert each uppercase letter to lowercase and insert underscores between them.
Test with a camel case string where a word in the middle is in all uppercase. It should convert each uppercase letter to lowercase and insert underscores between them.
Test with a null input. It should throw a NullPointerException because the method does not handle null values.
